pokedexEntries.di: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

pokedexEntries.prl: Its forelegs have a muscle-based system of generating electricity. Its body shines if endangered.

pokedexEntries.pt: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

pokedexEntries.sh: Electricity makes this Pokémon’s fur glow. Shinx sends signals to others of its kind by shaking the tip of its tail while the tail tip is shining brightly.

pokedexEntries.la: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.
